scope: Actual compiled Vue/router and installed TDesign Select interaction in headless Chromium with controlled local HTTP; no Orca/native/vendor calls.
problems: Clearing a pending search returns after incrementing searchRequest without clearing searchLoading.
Deselecting the only pending graph type increments graphRequest and clears nodes but leaves loading true.
fix: Clear only the appropriate loading flag in each empty-state branch; preserve the old-response request/scope fences.
fixture_correction: The initial search test looked for an absent loading-text node and was corrected to the installed Select spinner before confirming the product RED. No production changes occurred between these test setup runs.

commands.search_red: cd frontend/src && node --test --test-name-pattern='clearing an in-flight Wiki search' views/Wiki.page-actions.test.mjs
commands.graph_red: cd frontend/src && node --test --test-name-pattern='deselecting the only graph type' views/Wiki.page-actions.test.mjs
commands.related_green: cd frontend && npm run test:unit -- views/Wiki.page-actions.test.mjs views/Wiki.behavior.test.mjs views/Wiki.markdown.test.mjs utils/wiki-links.test.mjs utils/markdown-lite.images.test.mjs api/wiki-page-actions.test.mjs views/KnowledgeDetail.citation.test.mjs

limitations: Requires frozen Windows resource deployment and actual Orca/native interaction for page acceptance.
Suite/build durations are not product latency.
